summary: Allocates and fills an array of 292-byte display-mode structs from sound-manager entries. Clears the output list head/tail, prepares the sound manager with a3, then for each entry index up to the queried count allocates a struct via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, stores the index with DualFieldSetToSameValue, partially zero-initializes it, copies the entry's name string from the sound manager, records the index and zeroes two secondary fields, and registers the struct via DisplayModeEnumeratorWrapper. On zero-init failure it frees the partially built struct and returns the current count. Invoked by RenderUISystemGlobalInit during display/audio initialization.
